items.text: We're continuing to monitor and investigate bug reports on both PC and console, so please keep reporting any bugs you find in the Awakened Ancients DLC subforum.

Below is a comprehensive list of the latest changes on PC, including changes designed for better balancing and performance. If you are on console, it will take additional time for console changes to be released.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029017/1660cd01404c098ecbad6f930ef31bee6795961d.png"]
Camera now focuses on Eryk after he kills a boss in Boss Rush Mode. This will allow the player to see the portal if it spawned slightly out of screen.
Player can no longer skip an arena fight in PRS12.
Beast Mode attacks now restore 7 health on each successful hit.
Pale Reaper attack doesn’t pass I-frames anymore.
Fixed a problem that made player character stuck, if they get parried by Assassins or Lisa while in Beast Mode.
Fixed an issue which prevented Dungeon Mode characters from interacting with a Normal Mode tomb in Snow Passage and City.
Fixed a problem which could activate ‘The Last Faith’ achievement prematurely if player used some weapons for the first time.
Fixed a problem which triggered ‘The Longest Run’ achievement at the start of NG+, instead of at the end.
Fixed a problem which could lead to Eryk leaving the boss arena unintentionally while doing an action move against a boss.
Fixed a problem that made it possible for player to quit Boss Rush mode by an exit gate during Cold One Beast death animation.
Fixed an issue which allowed the player to jump out of bounds from balcony in Dungeon layer 2.
Fixed an issue that caused player to play idle animation if he died at the start of air dash.
Fixed a problem which caused Winged Fiend electrified ground pattern damage and effects to persist after her death.
Fixed an issue which made Yegor permanently immune to getting stunned if he got hit by a harpoon while facing a wall.
Fixed a problem with Spanish localization UI.

Since the release of Awakened Ancients DLC, we've been closely monitoring our communities and tracking any bugs that you report. Below is a comprehensive list of the latest changes on PC, including changes designed for better balancing and performance.
If you are on console, it will take additional time for console changes to be released. Please bear with us, and post any bugs you find in the Awakened Ancients DLC subforum.
Added auto resolution scaling at the start of the game, now it will detect your display and automatically set the resolution up to 1920x1080.
Added keybind change that allows you to close the map with the button that opens it.
Updated the credits scene in the main menu.

Characters in Dungeon Mode no longer scale with Eryk’s weapon level and Heart of Nycrux bonuses, instead they will get the current NG+ moon upgrade and level 2 weapon. Players can still get Eryk’s consumables, charms, stigmas, healing holster upgrades and metroidvania abilities.
Fixed an issue which caused Dungeon Entrance and Transform Altar to be slightly rotated and falling briefly to their position after scene load.
Removed NG+ Arcane level cap after NG+3, now the maximum level will be increasing by 10 after that, just like the previous levels.
NG+ Arcane levels are now locked behind blueprints, just like melee weapons, with the exception that they do not need to be given to Mariano beforehand.
Changed NG+ Arcane spell damage multiplier 0.1→0.06, and secondary multiplier 0.05→0.035
Changes to enemy and boss scaling related to health and damage for each NG+.
Enemies and bosses will now continue to scale after NG+5 with the exception of damage.
Those will now scale additionally based on current NG+ level: Stigma of Reprive, Stigma of Transcendence, Throwable bombs, boxes, chairs.
Fixed an issue which made Old Butcher and Eldritch Wight to use incorrect scaling in NG+, health is now greatly reduced.
Fixed a problem with all localizations which made the English version to show up for Sandy dialogue when getting the reward.
Fixed a problem with Polish localization which made the text overlap for details in Consecrated Flame details.
Fixed a problem with Italian localization which showed description and not the usage text for Labradorite gemstone.
Fixed a problem with Spanish localization which caused game to sometimes freeze when pass through tutorial was about to show.
Fixed a problem with Russian localization which made the text overlap in Arcane Altar menu.
Removed healing that occurred after Beast Mode expiring.
Fixed a problem which allowed charms to be stacked.
Fixed an issue which made enemies stuck and invulnerable if killed by the dark damage over time effect.
Increased base damage for Nightfall Blade, Nighttide's Rout, Skullcleaver, Colonel's Blunderbuss, Federal Admiral’s Cannon, Barsov’s Electrocution.
Increased skill damage for Nightfall Blade, Nighttide's Rout, Skullcleaver, Reclaimed Blade, Muramasa.
Reduced skill damage for Firestriker, Leporidae's Spirit, Severance Reaper, Holy Winged Axe.
Firestriker: Increased projectile hitbox size.
Illygarth Boreal Blade: Reduced sword projectile damage.
Rift of Blood: Fixed a problem which turned weapon into Firestriker until player stopped attacking when transitioning from air attack 2 to grounded combo.
Doppietta: Increased damage bonus against large enemies and giant enemies.
Consecrated Flame: Increased damage max health scaling against enemies and bosses
Barsov's Electrocution
Increased electrocuted status.
Reduced mana cost by 1.
Lunar Heart Of The Ascended
Increased active hold duration.
No longer targets invulnerable enemies.
Removed time stop on impact.
Fixed impact particles not spawning in the proper position.
Muramasa
Reduced skill dark projectile damage.
Fixed inconsistency between Eryk and Kalar versions.
Leporidae’s Spirit
Reduced final combo spin damage.
Replaced Leporidae’s Spirit skill ground impact time stop to a camera shake.
Fixed a rare problem that made enemies play death animation twice.
Increased health of Plague Doctor, Doomed Atrocity, and Netherwing.
Can no longer parry charged attacks from Stray Cold One, Grotesque Courtier, and Cold One Shielder.
Old Vigilante: Fixed bullet SFX and VFX triggering when player was invulnerable.
Corrupted Wolf: Now must be able to reach the player to detect him and trigger burning behavior.
Cold One Shielder
Slightly increased charge time of slam pattern.
Adjusted position of charged attack effect.
Fixed an issue related to shielded enemies which could cause some damage to be nullified.
Plague Doctor
Increased animation speeds.
Increased flamethrower burned status.
Reduced flamethrower damage and active duration.
Increased dodge speed.
Removed starting cooldown of whip attack.
Reduced whip attack cooldown randomization bracket.
Reduced next pattern selection.
Doomed Atrocity
Increased range required to cast pattern.
Increased attack animation speed.
Reduced dark defense for Giant Patron, Edwyn, Harbinger of Nightmare, Eldritch Wight and Junas High Priest.
Amended amount of Nycrux rewarded from defeating Caterina and Annabella and Medeya.
Improved hitboxes on animations for Edwyn, Starlight Beast of Illygarth and Manfred.
Leena: Added frozen status immunity.
Starlight Beast of Illygarth: Reduced frost and electricity defenses.
Medeya: Reduced frost defense.
Burnt Wraith
Reduced fire and dark defense.
Added frozen status immunity.
Fixed cutscene visual issue.
Lisa
Increased flip animation speed and changed all flip variations to also use this bonus.
Increased flamethrower animation speed.
Fixed a spawning issue in Boss Rush Mode.
Fixed bullet SFX and VFX triggering when player was invulnerable.
Pyre Wight
Increased health.
Reduced fire defense.
Increased cooldown for selection of new pattern by 1 second.
Reduced flying speed.
Increased charged dash attack pattern hitbox size.
Increased recast of ultimate cooldown by 1 pattern.
Reduced fire pillar damage.
Changed positioning of explosions after infernal fall pattern.
Added 2 more explosion after infernal fall on phase 2.
Infernal fall explosions will now have lower volume and pitch randomization.
Reduced fire orb explosion sound volume.
Flash Cloak
Increased health.
Reduced electricity defense.
Reduced cooldowns of quick dash and attack.
Reduced minimum range to start charged slash.
Increase speed of Electricity sphere projectiles.
Increased ultimate duration.
Increased ultimate spinning blade damage.
Reduced patterns required to force recast of ultimate by 3 patterns.
Reduced cooldowns before next pattern after normal slash, charged slashg and ultimate.
Unforgiven
Increased health.
Reduced frost defense.
Reduced jump cooldown.
Increased cooldown of projectile attack by 1 pattern.
Increased cooldown for selection of new pattern by 1 second.
Reduced jump whip attack by 1 pattern selection.
Reduced patterns required to force recast of ultimate by 1 pattern.
Increased speed and damage of frost spike rune projectiles.
Reduced cooldown of spawning a new rune.
Increased rune speed and time required to reach top speed.
Increased shield scaling from max health.
Increased maximum shield value that can be stacked.
Fixed an issue with frost beam hitbox in air.
Fixed a visual problem with frost beam particles.
Winged Fiend
Increased health.
Increased blood defense.
Reduced fire defense.
Slightly increased hitbox size.
Reduced blood orbs charge duration.
Increased blood orb damage.
Red electricity orbs now pass iFrames, added white flash as a warning.
Teleporting no longer delays pattern selection cooldown.
Reduced blood spikes charge duration.
Reduced time required to do teleport if player is close.
Reduced delay before next sequence in ultimate.
Junas High Priest
Reduced health.
Reduced charge time of casting dark orb and dual slashes.
Increased teleport animation speed.
Increased active duration of dark orb by 3 seconds.
Reduced initial warning duration of dark orb.
Increased dual slashes projectile speed.
Increased raybeam cast animation speed.
Increased amount of clones needed to be killed.
Clones no longer have starting attack cooldown.
Reduced rest time after being found.
Fixed occasional issue of clones becoming invulnerable for short duration.
Fixed a problem that froze the game when player defeated this boss and left the arena before getting rewards.
Fixed a specific issue when Doomed Atrocity was summoned.
Prior to the Awakened Ancients DLC releasing, we're releasing a huge patch for The Last Faith as there have been many changes to the game.
Improved Eryk’s reactivity and several quality of life additions
Changes to many Weapons, Spells and Guns.
Changes to many Enemies and Bosses
New Items
New Executions
New Tutorials
New Options settings
Optimisation
Bug fixes
And more! (Check detailed changelog below)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029017/1660cd01404c098ecbad6f930ef31bee6795961d.png"]
Melee attacks can now be cancelled with Jump, Spell, or Gun actions, allowing players to avoid hits better and chain attacks for combo.
Guns and Spells actions can now be cancelled with Roll, Dodge, or Jump.
Ground Roll and Air Dash no longer share a cooldown.
You can now roll and dodge during an air attack performed close to the ground.
Combos started in air can now be continued on ground.
Beast Mode now has a significantly increased duration and heals Eryk when it concludes.
Parry now heals a moderate amount more and has a slightly reduced cost.
Heavy Attack charges slightly faster and has a consistent charged attack effect across all weapons.
Eryk gains moderate damage reduction while charging Heavy Attacks and when Stigma of Protection is active.
Slightly increased Power gain multiplier from dealing damage.
Added and improved camera shake for all spells and guns.
Added camera shake and controller vibration to all bombs and throwable object explosions.
Added camera shake to all execution animations.
Executions now heal Eryk for a tremendous amount and grant some bullets.
The chance to trigger an execution has been slightly increased.
Slightly increased status effects charge decay rate.
Significantly reduced active duration of all status effects.
Skull Cleaver: Skill direct damage significantly increased.
Blunderblade: Drastically reduced skill mana cost.
Firestriker Blade: Projectile now spawns closer to Eryk and has slightly increased damage; moderately reduced mana cost.
Illygarth Boreal Blade: Projectile now spawns closer to Eryk and has slightly increased damage; moderately reduced mana cost.
The Devourer of the Betrayed: Skill direct damage significantly increased; added one more explosion and greatly increased their damage.
Stormchaser Macewhip: Slightly increased skill base damage.
Ethereal Great Blade: Skill damage significantly increased.
Added usage descriptions to all gun tooltips.
Slightly increased bullets damage hitbox size.
Nightbane Pistol: Slightly increased damage.
Federal Admiral’s Cannon: Moderately increased damage.
Leena’s Bow: Slightly Reduced damage; increased ammo consumption rate.
Hexbarrel Repeater: Increased ammo consumption rate.
Doppietta: Now deals bonus damage to large enemies and even more damage to giant enemies.
Barsov Electrocution: Slightly reduced direct damage but significantly increased Electrocuted buildup; increased late game scaling; reduced mana cost; increased vertical damage collider.
Infant’s Blessing: Moderately increased damage and reduced charge time.
Omniscient Eye Shield: Duration moderately reduced; damage moderately increased.
Spectre’s Lament: Slightly increased starting explosion damage; reduced hand damage and recovery time.
Curse of the Burned: Final explosion damage massively increased; individual orb damage slightly reduced.
Corrupted Star: Moderately increased damage.
Moonshade Tear: Slightly reduced damage.
Nightshade Key: A new consumable that teleports you to your last checkpoint, a temporary checkpoint, or the Manor.
Duplici Bullets: Restores 6 ammo upon use.
Blood Pastilles: A new consumable that removes the Bleeding status effect.
Pickable items now appear in front of enemy sprites for better visibility.
Increased level scaling for all bombs and slightly reducing their instinct scaling.
Added four new tutorials covering Healing, Dropping from Platforms, Temporary Checkpoints, and Point of No Return.
Swamp Water & Blood Lake: No longer slow player's attack speed.
Damage rebalanced for numerous traps including Electrified Water, Ice Spikes, Fire Beams, and more.
Added group cooldowns to Fire Barrels and Ice Boxes to prevent instant multi-hit bursts.
Slightly reduced hold duration of Nycrux bomb, additionally fastest flash will now be the shortest to act as a warning for the explosion.
Added a special sound effect when receiving unique rewards from NPCs.
Charm defense/resistance bonuses now correctly display in the UI stats.
Added 3 Middlemist Pastilles (burned status removal) to Walric corpse near Leena and Yegor boss fight.
Added Lady Annika corpse to City of Erlim when completing her quest.
Rebalanced health, damage, defenses, cooldown and rest time for all enemies.
Slightly increased Nycrux gain from many enemies.
Enemy health bars are now disabled while they are waiting for an execution.
Flying enemies now float slightly when idle.
Improved hitboxes and animation timing of many enemies
Added white flash or additional warnings to attacks that ignore I-frames.
Removed I-frame pass from all attacks without flash effect or particle warning.
When an flying enemy starts an attack, it no longer interrupts the idle animation.
Removed post-death damage from: Dreadful Wench, Infested Civilian, Rotting Hag, Strange Presence, Accursed Maiden, Sister of Sacrament, and Hallowed Priestess of Sacrament.

Many additional enemies can now be stunned by final melee combo attacks: Slum Hound, Deranged Woman, Ghastly Critter, White Lady, Afflicted Manservant, Grave Digger, Cathedral Priest, Flying Abomination, Necrogash, Frozen Necrogash, Slithering Monstrosity, Rotting Hag, Dreadful Wench, Strange Presence, Frozen Wraith, Hallowed Priestess of Sacrament.
Adjusted stun protection timing on attacks for numerous enemies, and removed stun protection in attacks for: Grave Hound, Faceless Child, Maritime Mutated Priest, Swamp Hound.

Removed damage reduction while attacking from: Giant of Sacrament, Maiden of the Deep, Masked Obscenity, Grotesque Courtier, Ornate Swordsman, Stray Cold One, Accursed Maiden, Hallowed Priestess of Sacrament.
Projectiles now target the player's last known position and are more telegraphed for Rotted Cold One, Frozen Rotted Cold One, Ghastly Critter Frozen Wight.
Blood trap will now repeat damage if player remains in its area: Grave Digger, Deranged Woman.
Deranged Woman, Swamp Hound, Grotesque Courtier & Sister of Sacrament: These foes can now be executed.
Primitive Cold One: Added texture of a frozen variant for snow area.
Grave Hound: Slightly increased detection range; run no longer deals damage or breaks objects.
Faceless One: Slightly increased run speed; reduced jump range, moved health bar down.
Rotted Cold One: Slightly increased charge time before attacking; slightly increased pattern range.
Frozen Rotted Cold One: Added corpse decay, projectile is slightly slower, added starting cooldown to his attack.
Deranged Woman: Moderately increased movement speed; slightly increased blood trap damage.
Strange Presence: Reduced grab attack damage and dash range.

Freakish Lady: Increased ice pillars pattern range and increased offset between each spawn, increased warning time, spawning is interrupted if caster dies or is stunned; increased charge times of all patterns.
Voracious Terror: Ice pillars will now appear with small delay.
Bootleg Corsair: Removed two bombs which spawned when enemy died.
Sick Defiler: Torch attack now deals additional damage over small duration.
Cathedral Priest: Health significantly reduced; movement speed slightly increased.
Hallowed Priestess of Sacrament: Slightly increased dive attack range; slightly reduced follow range when casting an attack.
Summoner Witch: Small projectile doesn’t trigger being hit animation anymore; dark energy effect is now quick damage intervals instead of burst and doesn’t knockdown anymore.
Glowing Pest: Will cast spell even if player is below or above the enemy.
Slithering Monstrosity: Added warning before spawning worms after death; lifesteal now heals based on maximum health and not damage done.
Masked Obscenity: Melee combo can now be parried.
Frost Corpse: Increased dash range and added stun immunity while it’s active.
Ornate Swordsman: First attack hitbox activates with a delay and has smaller hitbox.
Flying Abomination: Added warning before shooting projectiles.
Frozen Necrogash: Slightly increased rest times; slightly reduced all action cooldowns.
Rebalanced health, damage, defense, cooldown and rest time for all bosses.
Standardized timing and visual effects for action moves across several bosses.
Replaced Nightmare immunity with extreme resistance on several bosses to allow lingering damage effects to function.
Added white flash or additional warnings to attacks that ignore I-frames.
Removed I-frame pass from all attacks without flash effect or particle warning.
Increased stun duration for: Hermann, Yegor, Cold One Beast and Old Butcher.
Those bosses can use healing injection only once: Starborn Nighthunter (Sword), Starborn Nighthunter (Macewhip), Lisa.
Boss parry is not a grab attack anymore, it will trigger only if blocked an actual attack: Starborn Nighthunter (Sword), Starborn Nighthunter (Macewhip), Lisa.
Improved walk behaviour of: Giant Patron, Edwyn, Starlight Beast, Manfredd.
Giant Patron: Ultimate pattern will now activate below half health, instead of randomly when below that threshold.
Hermann: Blood trap will now repeat damage if player remains in it’s area; more rest time in phase 2.

Yegor & Leena: Changes to lightning strikes they are now spawned without the swing animation, reduced count by 1 in phase 1, removed random lightning strikes when Yegor is alone, lightning strikes now pass I-frames, now only 1 lightning can hit player at a time; slightly increased time before Leena harpoons explode, horizontal and angled fire projectiles now have the same speed.
Winged Pale Laments After climbing up, healthbars are hidden until damage reduction is removed; first enemy to die can never be executed, second one always has to be executed.
Cold One Beast & Old Butcher: Claw dash doesn’t knock down anymore, slash projectiles and fall attack will now travel at player’s recent position instead directly at him.
Edwyn: Added warning before beam attack activate, wind particles indicate the direction it will move towards, increased jump pattern cooldown, increased rest time.

Starborn Nighthunter (Sword): Removed dual fireball pattern; increased explosive candle charge time; slightly increased next action cooldown, moderately increased jump attack cooldown, successful parry heals less.

Starborn Nighthunter (Macewhip): Removed dead star and doppietta pattern; increased charge time of dual fireball pattern; slightly increased next action cooldown, moderately increased jump attack cooldown, successful parry heals less.

Lisa: Flaming sword duration is infinite but now it activates on phase 2 instead of randomly; reduced projectiles pattern recasts, and replaced air slash projectiles with ground slash projectiles, final hit of combo in phase 2 now has more charge time and plays charged attack sound and flash effect, added flamethrower sound.

Burnt Apostle: Reduced fire tornado waves in ultimate pattern by 1, but delay between next wave is slightly shorter; falls earlier at the end of ultimate pattern; slightly reduced charging time of thrust patterns; increased charging time of dash attack.

Manfred: Removed triple sky slash pattern; 2-hit slash is now a bit faster and charges less; removed possibility to teleport after the first slash from 2-hit slash pattern; increased delay before shadow fall pattern warning appears; increased charge time of kick pattern, and it’s ground break now travels further but delays before next wave is increased; blood orbs are faster and self detonate earlier; blood orbs don't have offset spawn randomization anymore; falling chandeliers moved to phase 2; removed shadow clone attacks from combo moves, and added them at the end of teleporting patterns; reduced damage of shadow clone attacks; some teleporting moves were moved to phase 2; improved audio when multiple sky slashes explode during ultimate pattern.

Caterina & Annabella: After dying to this boss, player may speak to them again after respawning; removed 0 rest time below 30% health in phase 2; Caterina’s air shoot projectile will now shoot at player last position while charging, instead of directly at him upon cast.

Laddak: Chasing thunder from both phases will now spawn closer to player and will have much faster follow speed, but will stop completely after white warning appears; lightning strike during Winged Pale Laments sequence will now appear more frequently.
Harbinger of Nightmare: Added cooldown group for Slam Attack and Water projectiles, only one can hit at a time; added particle warning to raybeam attack.
Eldritch Wight: Added more warning time for all tentacle attacks; moderately increased cooldown for tracking tentacle after teleport.
Medeya: Added shield bar UI, now it’s value can be seen just like health; shield can be cast only 4 times now instead of infinite, it will now activate on health thresholds, instead of cooldown.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029017/1660cd01404c098ecbad6f930ef31bee6795961d.png"]
Fixed memory management issues.
Fixed an issue in Caterina & Annabella and Medeya fight which caused all status effects and buffs to be permanent, and some attacks failing to hit when that happens.
Fixed an issue which caused Leena to be unresponsive, if Yegor died right before starting the ultimate.
Fixed a bug that prevented some weapon attacks from registering while using the Stigma of Catalysis.
Fixed an issue causing dark attacks to deal incorrect damage.
Fixed various shop icon issues with Mariano.
Fixed missing blood impact effects on several enemies.
Fixed many shadows being at the wrong offset.
Fixed several visual issues related to enemy flipping.
Fixed an issue which sometimes caused Strange Presence not to dash during portal attack.
Fixed a delayed animation issue with Z-door interactions.
Fixed an issue preventing Cosmic Echo third root from spawning when facing left near a ledge.
Fixed an issue causing the Glowing Pest to deal excessive damage at close range.
Fixed an issue where the Temporary Checkpoint could appear inactive upon entering a scene.
Fixed a missing button icon in the Italian language translation.
Fixed issues causing Nycrux Bomb to get stuck or teleport; improved animation synchronization with player.
Fixed an issue which caused Herman to deal double damage with one of his patterns.
Fixed an issue which caused Harbinger of Nightmare left head being immune to dark lingering damage.
Fixed an issue which allowed player to jump on a invisible wall during Medeya dash slash pattern.
Fixed an issue which enabled an invisible wall briefly whenever Eldritch Wight teleported.
Fixed Banks of the Moonshade Lake checkpoint appearing in the wrong order in the list.
Fixed visual issue of Giant of Sacrament projectile not appearing in intended position.
Reduced Focus Cost of Blunderblade weapon skill from 12 to 10.
Increased attack speed of Blackhall’s Double Menace.
Increased range of Nightbane Pistol, Blackhall’s Double Menace, and Hexbarrel Repeater.
Balance changes to some late-game bosses' damage and health: Manfredd, Cold One Beast, Old Butcher, Leena, Caterina & Annabella, Harbinger of Nightmare, Nyxaroth the Eldritch Wight.
Fix for the Harbringer of Nightmare pulling the player out of the screen.
Fix for gamepads switching multiple tabs on a single press
Potential fix for the player going outside the screen when moved by platforms
Potential fix for effects where the time passes (power-ups and stats) at the end of the game
Helenya stats reallocation is now accessible even after defeating Laddak
Nightmare extra attacks are now triggered only by direct attacks, and not by extra attacks by themselves
Fixed navigation pins breaking on the map
Various fixes for NPC markers (Annabella, Aldrich, Esk’s manor ghost, Madelyne)
Lost nycrux marker is now removed when the nycrux have been taken
Fixed an issue that sometimes made Eryk briefly immune to damage if he got hit while in grounded hurt animation
Fixed an issue that prevented Eryk from activating Firestriker Flamethrower weapon skill while running or attacking
Fixed text when initiating the reallocation from Helenya’s menu
Small map glitch fixes in Oxnevylle Manor
Curse Bearers,
PC Patch 1.5 for The Last Faith is now available!
This latest update brings widely requested options and enhancements, along with various fixes.
We hope that this new patch will greatly improve your experience with The Last Faith.
(Console patches coming late January 2024)
Controller Remapping Added
Player Stat Respec Added
Added NPC Markers on the Map
Stigmas are now activated with a single button.
Beast Mode is activated by the Hold+Action button.
Marksman Buffs and Game Balance Tuning
Controller Remapping added.
Player Stats Respec: After giving the Teacup to Helenya, players can reset their stats to the original level 1 class chosen.
Instant I-frames on Dodges
Charms can now be equipped independently, without the necessity of having any Stigma equipped.
Stigma and Beast Mode Activation Changes: Stigmas are now activated with a single button. Beast Mode is activated by Hold+Action button

Transformation Attack Adjustment (Beast Mode): Removed the unintended buff where transformation attacks in Beast Mode inflicted additional fire damage when fire powder was applied to the Nightfallblade.
Completion Score Adjustment: The completion score should now accurately reach 100%.
Decreased the Nycrux and stones cost for all firearms.
Nightbade Pistol and Doppietta Damage Increase
Federal-Issue Belt Bullet Increase: Increased the quantity of bullets received from 3 to 5.
Blunderblade Price Adjustment: Reduced its cost in Mariano’s shop to 4800.
Increased the duration of all Elemental Powders by 10 seconds.
General Power Absorption Tuning on spells and weapond
Reduced the Power cost and increased the usage time for Stigma Catalysis.
Increased the power and scaling of the Nighttide’s Rout.
Lowered the focus cost for the Nightfall blade skill attack.
Explosive barrels, frost trap boxes, and Nycrux bombs now deal more damage to enemies and less to the player.
Blood Trap Explosion Hitbox Size Reduction
Elemental powders on weapons no longer affect Eryk’s beast mode attacks.
NPC Display on Map: All NPCs are now displayed on the map.
Lost Nycrux is now shown on the map
General Enhancements: Added or improved particles and camera shake to every phase 2 transformation and ultimate pattern for all bosses.
Enhanced the hitbox collider in phase 2.
Prevented scenarios where the death cutscene didn't end.
Added a lightning strike at the end of the combo.
Fixed an issue causing the camera to lose its static state after the first attempt.
Fixed an issue preventing an extra fire projectile during the escape with a solo buff.
Yegor: Reduced damage collider and prevented knockouts during platform pattern.
Increased charge time for Yegor’s platform pattern to allow easier escape.
Added particles to indicate a buff after a partner's death.
Yegor's Max Poise Increase: Enhanced max poise after Leena’s death (85%→140%).
Leena's Fire Projectile Damage Removal
Prevented Yegor from growling while Leena speaks in the intro.
Fixed a problem causing the boss to get stuck near the gate.
Increased the hitbox of the fire sword stab attack.
Increased the charge time and made the warning for the shadow clone dash pattern clearer to the player.
Slowed the animation speed for the shadow clone slashes pattern.
Slowed the start speed of the leg stomp pattern.
Attack cooldown reduction has been removed in phase 2.
Phase 2 no longer initiates instantly; the boss now completes a special animation before entering it.
Increased attack cooldown from 3 to 5.
Increased escape cooldown from 1.8 to 2.5.
Raised the damage of dark pillars and introduced a cooldown group (40→100)
Reduced self harpoon damage from 15% of max HP to 10% of max HP.
Extended the trap damage interval from 0.1 to 0.2.
Fixed a bug where dark pillars would momentarily shift position after landing.
The scissor chase pattern will no longer respond to the player being behind; Annabella will flip only when near an arena corner.
Caterina will now teleport to the opposite corner after executing the Dark Pillar + Shoot combo pattern.
Enhanced the phase 2 transformation.
Implemented measures to prevent a known issue that caused the boss to ascend to excessive heights.
Phase 2 now initiates with the ultimate pattern, and visual particles have been incorporated to signal this change.
Introduced a warning indication for the scythe throw pattern.
Enlarged the warning size for thunder strikes to more accurately reflect the actual hitbox.
Extended the cooldown duration for the shield pattern by an additional 4 seconds.
Enhanced the casting speed for lightning slashes in the ultimate pattern by 30%.
Implemented measures to prevent the boss from becoming invisible or moving out of bounds.
Crystal pattern will now unlock later in the battle, and phase 2 will begin right after it reaches 50% health.
The boss will now teleport more frequently during the encounter.
Added particle warnings to the meteor pattern for better visibility.
Increased the head collider size, bringing it closer to the ground, which enables more weapons to deal critical damage.
Meteors will now fall from only two directions during phase 2.
Reduced the detection range to locate the boss after destroying the crystal from 15 to 13.5 units.
It is now easier to perform a parry.
The grab's active frames are now activated after a delay.

The grab hitbox has been modified to prevent catching the player when they are behind the enemy. Additionally, its range towards the ground has been increased, making it impossible to avoid the grab with a roll.
Quick flip has been removed from the shooting pattern.
The enemy in Broken Pass will now attempt to maintain a greater distance from its target to avoid situations where the player could attack it without receiving any retaliation while on high ground.
Resolved an issue where this enemy would teleport out of the scene if the player stood next to a ledge.
Fixed an issue where Eryk would become misaligned with the enemy if they were grabbed while getting onto a ladder.
Addressed an issue where the player could force the enemy to flip from above or below, canceling the teleport animation.
Fixed an issue that allowed the player to execute this enemy, even if they weren't stunned.

Weapon Level Status Update Fix: Corrected an issue where, after increasing a weapon's level, the status of other weapons was not updated. This led to some non-levelable weapons not being shaded out or some materials not updating.
Controller UI Reimplementation: Enhanced the UI to display the correct icons for various controllers
Improved support for unknown controllers
Credits can now be skipped after they have been watched once.

Fixed a bug that prevented raindrops from appearing in "Broken Pass".
Old Wymond Bug: Resolved an issue where Old Wymond's corpse could be found even though he was present and alive in another location.

Curse Bearers,
We're excited to announce the latest patch for The Last Faith on PC.
We've been utterly astounded by the incredible response to our game and are profoundly thankful for your overwhelming support.

Since launching the game just a few weeks ago, we've been diligently going through your comments, tuning into your videos, and heeding your feedback. Thanks to this, we have been able to develop a patch that focuses on the most important issues.
Be aware that the notes below contain SPOILERS. Read them at your own risk!
Gameplay Pause Feature: The game now pauses automatically when the full-screen UI is open.
Starter Combat Styles Changes: Starting classes now feature varied equipment, enhancing the initial gameplay experience.
Lost Nycrux: Dying in boss arenas now causes lost Nycrux to spawn outside the arena at the last checkpoint visited.
Shop Interface Improvement: Shops have been updated with an "All" tab for easier navigation and item selection.
Map Screen Enhancement: The map screen now displays the area where the player died.
Balancing Tweaks: We've made significant balancing improvements to enemies and bosses, aiming for a more challenging and fair gameplay experience.
Weapons and Spells Balancing: Both weapon and spell mechanics have been fine-tuned for better balance and diversity in combat strategies.
Achievement Fix: The Last Faith Achievement is now obtainable. Players who previously had this stuck should relaunch the updated game to trigger the achievement.
Ethereal Great Blade Nerf: Adjusted following player feedback for balanced gameplay.
Invulnerability Period Reduction: Reduced the period of invulnerability when using the Skill attack of the Ethereal Greatblade and Skullcleaver.
Illygarth Boreal Blade Buff: Enhanced for improved performance.
Scythe, Spinal Chain Blade, and Nightfall Blade Skill Nerf: Slightly reduced effectiveness based on player feedback.
Doppietta Power Increase: Now more powerful.
Nightbane Pistol Power Increase: Enhanced for greater effectiveness.
Blackhall’s Double Menace Power Increase: Strengthened for better performance.
Federal Admiral’s Cannon Power Increase: Upgraded for increased potency.
Increased Spell Damage: All spells now have increased damage output.
Starting load-outs are now unique to each Combat Style. Unselected load-out weapons can still be found throughout the world.

Contact Damage Removal: Removed contact damage from all enemies that previously had it.
Double Flip Prevention: Implemented actions to prevent the issue of enemies flipping twice in a row.
Flip Animation Speed Increase: Enhanced flip animation speed for all enemies by 6%-25%.
Mobility During Flipping for Flying Enemies: Flying enemies are now able to move while performing flip animations.
Flying Height Adjustment: Flying enemies will more frequently lower their flying height.
Reduced Stun Protection: Decreased stun protection duration by 3 seconds for Stray Hound, Faceless One, and Swamp Hound.
Randomized Patrol Start: Enemies will now initiate patrolling with a random starting animation offset.
Randomized Rest Behavior: Added randomization to enemies' rest behavior.
Universal Stun Vulnerability to Explosions: All enemies are now susceptible to being stunned by explosions.
Stun by Throwable Objects for Smaller Enemies: Small and medium-sized enemies can now be stunned by throwable objects.
Red Flash Indicator for Execution: Enemies will flash red when they are ready to be executed.
Persistent Shadow on Flat Ground Death: Shadows won’t disappear instantly if an enemy dies on flat ground.
Increased Reactivity of Certain Enemies: Enhanced the reactivity of enemies from the Junas Ministry, City of Erlim, and Ordens Regnant Palace.
Strengthened Specific Enemy Groups: Enemies in the Ordens Regnant Palace, Highwalls of Mythringal, and The Junas Ministry have been strengthened.
Weakened Snow Area Enemies: Enemies located in snowy areas are now slightly weaker.
Voice Sound Updates: Added new voice sounds for Old Vigilante, Vile Clergyman, Cathedral Priest, and Progenie.
Shooting Mechanic Adjustment: Removed the quick flip ability while shooting for Frozen Wight, Bootleg Corsair, Infected Wanderer, Swamp Hound, and Hallowed Rider.
Projectile Bounds Adjusted: Added projectile bounds for Frozen Rotted Cold One and Flying Abomination, eliminating the ability to shoot behind themselves.

Stun Protection Increased: Enhanced stun protection by 2 seconds for all enemies, with an additional 1-second increase for giant enemies. Endurance settings for Sister of Sacrament and Hallowed Priestess of Sacrament have been changed from medium to high.

Action Cooldown Reduction: Lowered action cooldown for Vile Clergyman, Accursed Maiden, Sister of Sacrament, Hallowed Priestess of Sacrament, Giant Patron, Grotesque Courtier, White Lady, and Ornate Swordsmanster. Also, implemented damage reduction while attacking for Accursed Maiden, Ornate Swordsmaster, Masked Obscenity, Sister of Sacrament, and Giant of Sacrament.
Transition Animation Fix: Corrected the poor transition from flip to idle animations for Deranged Woman and Voracious Terror.
Smoother Air Flip Animations: Enhanced air flip animations for winged enemies, including Voracious Terror, Rotted Cold One, Frozen Rotted Cold One, and Flying Abomination, to be smoother.

Hit Protection Removal: Removed hit protection during attacks for Stray Hound, Faceless One, Comrade Mutated, Primitive Cold One, Infected Pilgrim, Infected Wanderer, Sick Defiler, Old Vigilante, Swamp Hound, Frost Corpse, Bootleg Corsair, Ghastly Critter, Summoner Witch, Infected Witch, Afflicted Manservant, Hallowed Rider, Grave Digger, Flying Abomination, Rotted Cold One, Frozen Rotted Cold One, and Putrid Deformity.

Enhanced Attack Mechanic: Introduced a charge effect to enemy attacks that bypass Iframes for Necrogash, Bereaved Maiden, Cold One Shielder, Giant of Sacrament, Frozen Necrogash, Slithering Monstrosity, Dreadful Wench, Stray Cold One, Grotesque Courtier, Voracious Terror, and Maiden of The Deep.

Enhanced Trap Warning: Added a warning to the blood trap.
Improved Evasion Behavior: The Grave Digger's runaway behavior is now more reactive.
Increased Reactivity: Enhanced overall reactivity.
Cooldown Removal: Removed run cooldown.

Beam Bound Reduction: Reduced the bounds of the beam.

Jump Strength Reduction: Decreased the strength of jumps.
Projectile Catching Fix: Resolved an issue preventing the catching of projectiles.

Explosive Death Addition: Added damage to death explosion.
